answer: Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 52% independent neighbours on the funding graph. Because the nectar calculation reruns each epoch, the juniper weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the yarrow settlement publishes the resulting shares. A tight ring of 155 clones therefore holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. That is 20 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
